Content production policy regarding phimosis treatment on this site

This site is operated with the aim of providing accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers regarding aesthetic medicine and male genital treatment.

Medical procedures such as medical diets, double plastic surgery, and phimosis surgery are important topics that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

In particular, regarding phimosis surgery, the necessity and options for treatment vary depending on the condition, such as pseudophimosis, true phimosis, and cantonal phimosis.

Therefore, we provide easy-to-understand explanations of not only surgical methods and costs, but also the medical necessity, side effects, risks, and postoperative course.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.
